body:
With an empty `node_modules/.vite`, the first dev load of an example discovers dependencies late (`@effect/platform-browser, clsx, effect/http, effect/persistence, parse5`), and Vite logs `optimized dependencies changed. reloading`. Model preservation flushes on `vite:beforeFullReload`, so the reloaded page restores the Model captured mid-load and skips init (runtime.ts, restore path). A Query that was `Loading` at flush time is restored as `Loading`, its fetch Command is never reissued, and the page stays on the loading state.

## Reproduction

```sh
rm -rf examples/api-cache-query/node_modules/.vite
cd packages/examples-e2e
EXAMPLE_SLUG=api-cache-query pnpm test:e2e --retries=0
```

Result: 2 failed, 1 passed (`toBeVisible` times out waiting for loaded content). Running the same command again on the now-warm cache gives 3 passed. With `CI=1` (retries 2) the failures are reported as `flaky`, so the examples E2E job passes and hides them. The same happens with other Query-backed examples.

## Observations

- A single cold tab opened by hand recovers. Vite still forces the reload (navigation type `reload`), but the page finishes loading. So far I have only reproduced the hang under Playwright with parallel workers.
- A consumer app scaffolded with create-foldkit-app (api-cache-query, foldkit from npm) did not force a reload on a cold cache. The late discovery appears specific to the monorepo examples, which alias `foldkit/*` to source.
- Possibly related: the plugin keys preserved Models by runtime id only, shares that store across connected clients, and sends `foldkit:restore-model` with `server.ws.send`, which broadcasts. Three concurrent cold tabs in one browser did not reproduce the hang, so this is unconfirmed.

## Possible directions

- Do not preserve or restore across a reload caused by dependency optimization. Vite does not distinguish that reload in `vite:beforeFullReload`, so this would need a signal from the plugin.
- Have the examples Vite config include these deps in `optimizeDeps.include`, so a cold start does not trigger a forced reload.

comments.body:
Correction after instrumenting the failure: Model preservation is not involved, and the first paragraph above describes the wrong mechanism.

I ran the api-cache-query E2E pattern (3 parallel Playwright workers, cold `node_modules/.vite`) with every page's HMR WebSocket frames logged. In the failing run:

- Vite discovered `@effect/platform-browser, clsx, effect/http, effect/persistence, parse5` late and broadcast `full-reload`.
- One page had already connected its HMR socket. It received the reload, booted fresh (`foldkit:request-model` answered with no Model), and loaded.
- The other two pages connected their sockets just after the broadcast and never received it. Their module requests had already hit `504 (Outdated Optimize Dep)`, so the entry never executed. Their `body` stayed empty, and they never sent `foldkit:request-model`.

A standalone script that opened the same three pages slightly earlier saw all three receive the reload, and every page loaded. So the hang depends on when each page's HMR socket connects relative to the optimizer's reload, which is why single tabs usually recover and CI retries hide it.

Apps scaffolded with create-foldkit-app (foldkit from npm) did not trigger a forced reload on a cold cache. The late discovery looks specific to the monorepo examples, which alias `foldkit/*` to source while the plugin sets `optimizeDeps.exclude: ['foldkit']`. I have not verified that the exclusion is what stops the scanner from crawling those imports.

Possible directions: pre-include the discovered deps in the examples' shared Vite config (`optimizeDeps.include`), or have the E2E harness warm the dev server and wait for optimization before starting workers.

title: Examples E2E: on a cold Vite cache, parallel pages miss the dep-optimizer reload and render blank (hidden by retries)
